traces.title: Read/listen and three private self-reports
traces.explanation: No observed submitted answer exists; no correctness or checked credit can be produced.

traces.title: Primary responses, assistance, retries and unresolved states
traces.explanation: Only the first final unassisted produced response per opportunity is eligible. The first incorrect answer remains in the denominator despite a correct retry. Mode switching retains the private reveal.

traces.title: Manual review and rubric revision at successive as-of cutoffs
traces.explanation: The same answer is submitted once; late grading and a later rubric correction do not create new responses or change its 270-second interval.

traces.title: Delayed checks with real elapsed time and intervening history
traces.explanation: The 7–9 day reporting window is an example chosen for this fixture, not an optimal review interval. Recorded review and unknown histories remain visible.

traces.title: Offset-aware timestamps
traces.explanation: Explicit UTC offsets yield 90,000 seconds, not a calendar-day assumption of 86,400.

traces.title: Application with new, repeated, unknown and assisted context
traces.explanation: Freshness is scoped to known recorded app history and a proposed new context. A new prompt version in the same family is still previously encountered.
